tracepcap.name: viewer
tracepcap.description: TracePcap viewer: reads captures, networks, findings and reports. What it may do is set in TracePcap, Settings > Permissions. Assign it to groups here.

tracepcap.name: analyst
tracepcap.description: TracePcap analyst: investigates (upload, ask the AI, label, override, capture and network rules). What it may do is set in TracePcap, Settings > Permissions. Assign it to groups here.

tracepcap.name: lead
tracepcap.description: TracePcap lead: curates what everyone shares (global rules, network settings, anyone's captures, the audit log). What it may do is set in TracePcap, Settings > Permissions. Assign it to groups here.

tracepcap.name: admin
tracepcap.description: TracePcap admin: every permission, always, including changing roles. What it may do is set in TracePcap, Settings > Permissions. Assign it to groups here.
